description: The chart illustrates performance scores for three models across several evaluation sets, shown as grouped vertical bars for each dataset category. The horizontal axis contains the categories PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, arranged left to right in that order; no explicit axis label is visible. The vertical axis represents a numeric score on a linear scale, with values displayed as data labels above each bar; the visible values range from about 0.42 up to 1.00, and no tick marks or units are shown. Each category contains three adjacent bars: a dark purple bar labeled “RedWhale (our),” a light blue bar labeled “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and a light gray bar labeled “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base).” For PT-EVAL, the bars are approximately 0.42 (dark purple), 0.46 (light blue), and 1.00 (light gray). For KoBEST-BQ, they are about 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00; for KoBEST-CP, about 0.72, 0.74, and 1.00; for KoBEST-HS, about 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00; for KoBEST-SN, about 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00; and for AVG, about 0.59, 0.61, and 1.00. The bars are grouped by dataset with consistent color coding across groups, and there is no visible sorting by value or special visual emphasis beyond the numeric annotations above the bars.
